title: Auth module currently fails Ruff lint
reasoning: The project lint configuration selects Pyflakes F rules. Running Ruff on this file reports F401 for the unused verify_api_token import and F821 for the undefined request name in the two unreachable lines after revoke_api_token returns. This blocks the configured lint command even though the runtime route path may not execute those lines.
recommendation: Remove the unused verify_api_token import and delete or correctly place the stray check_auth_rate_limit(request) calls with a real Request parameter in the intended endpoint.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked feature has no tests, and ordinary route tests would not catch static lint failures unless the lint command is part of verification.
suggestedRegressionTest: Keep the configured Ruff lint command in CI for app/api/auth.py so undefined names and unused imports fail before release.
minimumFixScope: Edit app/api/auth.py to satisfy Ruff F401/F821; no database or API contract change is required.
